posts.zh:
dsh-codegraph 已收录到 DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store。DSH 插件，注册 13 个原生 codegraph_* 工具包装 codegraph CLI，让代理初始化、维护并查询预索引的代码知识图谱（符号查询、区域探索、节点轨迹、callers/callees、影响分析、受影响测试），无需 grep 文件。

查看来源与安装：https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-b3e695be979c409d6bde.html
posts.en:
dsh-codegraph is now listed on the DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store. DSH bundle that registers 13 native codegraph_* tools wrapping the codegraph CLI, so agents bootstrap, maintain, and query a pre-indexed code knowledge graph (symbol query, explore, node trail, callers/callees, impact, affected tests) instead of grepping files.

Source and install details: https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-b3e695be979c409d6bde.html
